dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product has places where people type inside a box that is not a text field's: a message written in a capsule that also holds its actions and its attachments, the bar of a search, a title edited where it stands. The box is drawn by what holds the typing; what is typed still needs its text style, its colors at rest and disabled, the color of its hint, its caret and its selection, and the motion of a height that follows its lines.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything an embedded text input reads: the text style of what is typed and of its placeholder, their colors at rest and disabled, the caret's color, the selection's highlight and the color of the text on it, and the duration and the curve of a height that follows the lines.
rules: An embedded text input is the typing alone. It has no container, edge, fill, corner, padding, label, message, icon or state layer, and so no token for any of them: the box is drawn by whatever holds it, from that holder's tokens.
It draws no focus indication. The holder draws it on its own box while the input has focus (on the web, a rule on :focus-within); a caret is not a focus indication.
Always give it a label: it is the accessible name, and nothing else names it. A placeholder is never the name.
Use it only inside a box that is the holder's own and is drawn nowhere else. Where the box is a text field's box, use the Text input (or the Text field, which is a Field around one).
It has no state-layer.color: that token names the color a state mixes into a container, and it has no container. Hover and focus change nothing it draws.
error and required change nothing it draws; they are exposed to assistive technology. Mark an error on the holder's box.

The height of a multi-line input follows its lines between minRows and maxRows and changes over motion.resize-duration; nothing else of it moves. Do not animate the holder separately: it follows the input's height.
Keep input.typescale at 16 px or more: a touch browser zooms into smaller text.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component. A holder never sets them: one instance is set apart by the product, on that element.

typescale.$description: The typed text and the placeholder. One line of it is the unit minRows and maxRows count in. 16 px, so that a touch browser does not zoom into the input.

color.$description: The hint in the empty input.
The insertion point: the one thing the input itself shows of having focus. It is not the focus indication, which is the holder's.

The highlight behind selected text, in every state. Selected text is the one that is chosen now, and the system marks that with a primary fill under on-primary content wherever it appears. Pair: selection.content.color.
The text on the highlight. A layer whose highlight is a tint that keeps the typed text readable sets this to the text's color.

resize-duration.$description: How long the height takes to change when the number of lines shown changes (ETI-8).
